subject: Your first 28 days in Bass Booster
preview_text: 30 hours of boosted audio. 200% louder moments. Here's what you unlocked.
body_paragraphs: You've been with us for 28 days now. That's 672 hours of music, movies, and games—and I bet some of those hits actually thumped. Let’s talk about what that means.

We crunched the numbers. In your first month, you pushed the volume past the system limit at least a dozen times. That 3D Surround? You used it on three different tracks, and the Bass Virtualizer kicked in on every EDM drop. Your phone’s speakers have never worked this hard.

This is where most people hit a wall. The free boost is solid, but the full 10-band EQ is what turns a decent beat into a chest-rattling experience. You’ve already felt the difference. Now imagine dialing in the exact frequency that makes that 808 kick like a subwoofer.

Open the app right now. Tap the Boost slider and hold it at max for 10 seconds. Then hit the EQ and adjust the 60Hz band up by 3dB. That’s the sound of progress. P.S. You’re one of 9,000 people boosting right now—you’re not alone in this.
cta_text: Open Bass Booster and feel the drop
